transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora. I'm a clinical conversational agent here to help you with any questions you might have about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions for me today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have some questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after your surgery. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can continue using any eye drops you were using before your operation, such as for dry eyes, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. However, if you have significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation, but this should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it's okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. So, just to confirm, all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thanks again!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent successfully conveyed all three content points in a single turn. In turn 6, Dora states, "It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses," covering `normal_sensitivity_reassurance`. The agent then continues, "However, if you have significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further," which covers `escalation_criteria`. Finally, Dora concludes with, "If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside," addressing `mild_case_advice`.
